_readme: ONE list that drives checkout (allowed_countries + shipping_options), Offer/OfferShippingDetails/MerchantReturnPolicy JSON-LD, the Merchant Center feed and the visible 'ships to' lines. Only `live` is ever emitted. `pending` is a candidate list: it is NEVER read by checkout, schema, feed or pages (a test fails the build if it leaks). To launch a country now: add its code to `liveWave` (one-line data change; its row stays in `pending`, shipping + delivery estimate + faster option come from its `route` in `deliveryRoutes`). Legacy manual way: fill printSite, shippingRate, handlingDays, transitDays from IngramSpark's ship-to data (pmpublish 2026-11-09, /home/deploy/aeo-state/fhb-ingram-shipto-20261108.json), set status live, and move the row from `pending` to `live`. Rates are fixed per order (Stripe shipping rates cannot vary by item count). shippingRate.value is a decimal string in `currency`.

landedCost._readme: Per-copy IngramSpark LANDED cost in USD (print + handling + cheapest TRACKED, DUTY-PAID shipping, qty 1) for the 6x9 hardcover (hc) and paperback (pb). Drives the margin floor in functions/dvc-checkout.ts via src/lib/marginGuard.ts: a discount that would take net per item below MIN_NET_USD is dropped for that order. basis MEASURED = read from the IngramSpark calculator; ZONE_MAX = unmeasured, takes the highest measured cost in its zone (conservative). A live row WITHOUT landed_cost_usd gets no discount (fails closed), except US, which ships free inside the unit price and is outside the guard.

farBand._readme: Kevin 2026-11-08 (2A): the first-order 15% (WELCOME15) is never shown or applied in the farthest shipping band. Flag = zone in [Africa, Middle East] or (zone Asia-Pacific and code != AU), per the zones in this file; it covers South and Southeast Asia. Row field: far_band. Enforced in src/lib/marginGuard.ts (welcomeOffered) on top of the dynamic MIN_NET_USD guard.

deliveryRoutes._readme: Delivery model per route. A pending row names its route. handlingDays = Ingram dispatch in business days (measured: economy 5 paperback / 10 hardcover, rush 1 / 2). transitDays = carrier transit in business days, an ESTIMATE from conservative published carrier ranges (Ingram's calculator shows dispatch only; transit is UNMEASURED). fast = the optional buyer-paid 'Faster delivery' option: extra_usd is OUR extra cost per copy = (rush print - economy print) + (fastest reasonable tracked duty-paid method - the free method), USD at the fx above, rounded UP to the cent. Its price is computed in src/lib/shipCountries.ts (fastPriceCents) as extra x 1.15 plus the Stripe fee on it, rounded up to a .99 price point, and scales with copies. fast=null means the option is NOT offered. Where no sane faster tracked duty-paid method exists the option is rush PRINT only (label 'Priority printing', extra = rush print delta, transit unchanged). Full table + sources: /home/deploy/aeo-state/fhb-intl-decisions-2kd-20261108.json.
